Game Overview

Project: Survival is a zombie game built around enter a zombie-infested city where every step is a battle for survival. Navigate perilous maps, scavenge for weapons, and tackle relentless missions. Confront diverse zombie threats, amass loot, upgrade your arsenal, and leverage strategic revives. It's a test of skill and endurance—survive the chaos and climb the ranks.
